explanation: Only allow soak_rag_0 when the rag is both held and dipped under soap; blocks futile or premature soaks.
Once the rag is already placed into the sink for cleaning, avoid repeating the place_inside_sink_7 action.
Prevent placing the rag into the sink unless the robot is actually holding the rag.
Block redundant toggles once the sink is already on, to avoid wasting steps.
Only allow placing the bucket in the sink when the robot is holding the bucket.
Prevent placing the bucket into the sink again once it is already inside.
Do not attempt to grasp the rag with the left gripper if it is already held.
Do not attempt to grasp the rag with the right gripper if it is already held.
